objective: Prevent false universal closure of TOOL_LEARNING_SUCCESS_ROUTE_NONINFERIOR by proving the minimum observability premise required in addition to identity completeness and safe-probe enforcement.

frozen_target_literals.required_action: Discover candidate tools if needed, select the least-cost admissible route that can satisfy the subproblem, and update capability evidence from observed outcomes
frozen_target_literals.scope: Unknown/changing tool ecosystem to verified usable route

finding.counterexample: Two target worlds expose identical allowed information. CHEAP costs 1 and cannot be probed for CAP_A; EXPENSIVE costs 2 and has current positive evidence. In W0 CHEAP lacks CAP_A, so validity requires EXPENSIVE. In W1 CHEAP has CAP_A, so global least-cost correctness requires CHEAP. Because the differing fact is not observable, no policy can guarantee both obligations in both worlds.
finding.necessary_observability_condition: Every hidden capability fact capable of changing the globally least-cost valid-route decision must be decidable before commitment from authorized public evidence or an allowed safe probe.

impact_on_open_candidates.dynamic_v3: Already falsified independently by cheaper-undiscovered-route ordering.
impact_on_open_candidates.dynamic_v4_safe_probe_gate: Necessary soundness repair, but it cannot by itself establish universal actual-route least-cost noninferiority unless the observability condition is also discharged.
impact_on_open_candidates.owned_identity_gateway: Can discharge tool-identity enumeration only; it does not by itself make hidden capability truth observable.
impact_on_open_candidates.complete_source_relation: Can discharge identity discovery completeness only; it does not by itself discharge capability observability completeness.
